About Gallery Book

Mobile grooming, one dog at a time.

I'm Marisol — a one-woman grooming service serving Denver's dogs right at their own front door. No franchise, no front desk, just me and your dog.

About

I've been grooming dogs professionally for a few years now, and about a year ago I decided to take it on the road — I was tired of watching anxious dogs get worked up just from the car ride to a salon, and figured there had to be a better way. So now I bring the tub, the table, and the clippers to you. I work solo, by appointment, across the Denver metro area, and I only book as many dogs in a day as I can actually give my full attention to. That's it — no waiting room, no other groomers, just your dog getting groomed in a space they already know.

A little bit of the day-to-day

"Marisol showed up right on time and Biscuit didn't even whine getting in the tub, which never happens. He smells amazing."

— Priya, mom to Biscuit

"Having someone come to the house is a total game changer for us. No carrier, no car anxiety, just a happy dog when it's done."

— Danny, dad to Waffles
